//==
// # IIndexable collection interfaces
//
// Counting, typed positions, and random access by index in one to four
// dimensions. All collections are immutable; operations that "modify" return new
// collections.

// Has a finite number of elements.
interface ICountable
{
    Count(x: Self): Integer;
}
